fixes.finding: A new output directory inside repo or reader_side could create untracked files without changing pinned existing files.
fixes.resolution: Reject protected core, fixture and test tree destinations before mkdir; test proves no tree mutation.

fixes.finding: Edited fixture IDs could escape generated output paths or collide.
fixes.resolution: Validate bounded filesystem-safe unique task IDs across all phases before any probe artifact writes; negative tests confirm empty output remains.

fixes.finding: An exit-0 malformed/mismatched worker result could lose its raw receipt.
fixes.resolution: Persist raw stdout/stderr/exit before parsing; augment rejection reason or validated execution afterward; negative tests retain both malformed and mismatched results.

remaining_acceptance: No live model-driven editor or responder observed in this adaptation.
No blind held-out or statistical generalization study.
Independent human reader trial remains separate.
